name: 涟漪 (Ripple) v0.1.14
body:
## 更新内容 / What's New（安卓 v0.1.14）

- UI 布局大幅优化升级：应用限制页改为更清晰的分区结构，休息进度和二级入口一次看全；限制入口会按屏幕宽度和字号自动排布，减少中文孤字换行；大字号下休息说明不再被截断；解锁等弹窗对比度和可读性增强；引导页在矮屏上会缩放插画，步骤圆点与「第 x / 4 步」对齐，英文短屏也不再裁切正文。
- 中文界面统一「自律」相关命名和说明（例如全局自律、打开前先停一下），不改你已经保存的规则名称。
- 「全局自律」现在会写清计时范围；会话状态未知时也会明确提示，避免误以为没在计时。
- 修复打开前等待倒计时结束后点「继续打开」没反应，并避免等待页反复重启把点击冲掉。
- 修复无障碍服务重新连接后，前台应用状态没刷新导致部分情况下计时不准。
- 修复多个自律时段重叠时，用量累计和限制互相冲突的问题。
- 解锁码每天最多成功使用 5 次，次数不可调整；次数用尽后会直接说明今天不能再用。
- 打开次数用完时的展示更准确；英文界面的打开次数单位改为 times。
- 安卓：冷启动时等前台就绪再建界面，减少一进来就卡住或空白的情况；用量检查点会及时写入，避免进程被杀后计数回退。
- 已知：部分手机打开受限应用时仍可能短暂显示应用画面；小米相关问题尚未完成真机回测。
- iPhone：本包未更新。当前可下载的 iPhone 版仍是 v0.1.5。新版 iOS 工程已能无签名编译并嵌入 Screen Time 扩展，但本机 Xcode 未登录开发者账号，且现有描述文件缺少 Family Controls 与 App Group，正式签名未通过，因此没有发布新的 IPA。

- UI layout upgrade: clearer app-limits structure with rest progress and secondary entries; adaptive entry width for Chinese line breaks; rest text no longer clipped at large font sizes; clearer unlock dialogs; onboarding art scales on short screens and step dots match “Step x of 4”.
- Unified visible Chinese focus-mode wording without renaming saved rules.
- Global Focus Mode now states its timing scope and unknown session status more clearly.
- Fixed Continue after the wait countdown, and stopped the wait page from relaunching over the tap.
- Fixed incorrect timing after Accessibility reconnect when foreground state was stale.
- Fixed usage and restriction conflicts when focus sessions overlap.
- Unlock codes succeed at most 5 times per day; that limit is fixed, with a clear exhausted state.
- More accurate opens-used-up display; English opens unit is “times”.
- Android: wait for foreground readiness before creating the UI; persist usage checkpoints so counts survive process death.
- Known: a blocked app may still flash briefly on some phones; Xiaomi issues still need real-device retest.
- iPhone: not updated in this package. The downloadable iPhone build remains v0.1.5. The new iOS tree compiles unsigned with Screen Time extensions embedded, but Xcode has no signed-in developer account and current profiles lack Family Controls and the App Group, so no new IPA was published.
